scripts.analyze-build: pnpm validate-node-version && cross-env ANALYZE_BUNDLE=true next build --webpack
scripts.lint: pnpm run eslint && pnpm run prettier
scripts.lint:errors: pnpm exec eslint --quiet --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern . && pnpm run prettier
scripts.format: pnpm run prettier:format && pnpm run eslint:format
scripts.eslint:changed: FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR --relative HEAD -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mts' '*.js' '*.cjs' '*.mjs'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mts' '*.js' '*.cjs' '*.mjs'); if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo 'No changed files to lint.'; else ESLINT_PROGRESS_LABEL=linting node ./tooling/eslint-config-web/eslint-progress.mjs --fix --cache --cache-strategy content --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern $FILES; fi
scripts.create-migrations: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- prisma migrate dev --create-only
scripts.migrate-dev: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- prisma migrate dev && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.migrate-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- prisma migrate dev && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.migrate-reset: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- prisma migrate reset && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.migrate-reset-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- prisma migrate reset && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.pushdb: pnpm validate-node-version && prisma db push && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.generate-client: pnpm validate-node-version && prisma generate && pnpm patch-generated-client
scripts.seeddb: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development prisma db seed
scripts.seeddb-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- prisma db seed
scripts.jsonify-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- npx tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/jsonify/index.ts --live=true && pnpm format-json-fixtures
scripts.sync-repositories: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- npx tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/sync-repositories.ts
scripts.sync-repositories-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- npx tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/sync-repositories.ts
scripts.calculate-experience: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-dev-env-setup -- npx tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/calculate-experience.ts
scripts.calculate-experience-prod: pnpm validate-node-version && pnpm manual-prod-env-setup -- npx tsx --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src/scripts/calculate-experience.ts
